C0731.title: Samsung Electronics Chip Secrets Leaked via ChatGPT
C0731.summary: Shortly after Samsung Electronics allowed use of ChatGPT, reports described improper-use risks. Employees reportedly entered sensitive data into an external generative AI service, and the content could be stored by the external service or used for training, creating leakage risk. The incident highlights the need for enterprises adopting generative AI tools to restrict sensitive-data input, configure auditing, and establish employee usage rules.

references.title: [Exclusive] Fears Become Reality: Samsung Electronics Faces ChatGPT Misuse Right After Unlocking Access
